exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instruction: Lie flat on a bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Lower the barbell to your mid-chest in a controlled motion. Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instruction: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward. Curl the weights up by bending your elbows while keeping them close to your body. Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instruction: Sit at the cable row machine with your feet braced and back straight. Pull the handle toward your lower abdomen while squeezing your shoulder blades together. Slowly return the handle to the starting position.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.instruction: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Press the weights upward until your arms are fully extended overhead. Lower them back down in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instruction: Place the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Push through your heels to return to standing.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.instruction: Lie face down on the hamstring curl machine with the pad resting on your lower legs. Curl your heels toward your glutes while keeping your hips down. Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Tricep pushdown
exercises.instruction: Stand facing a cable machine holding the bar with your elbows close to your sides. Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended. Slowly return to the starting position while keeping control.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instruction: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and grip the barbell just outside your knees. Keep your back straight and lift the bar by extending your hips and knees. Lower the bar back to the ground in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Pull up
exercises.instruction: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you. Pull your body upward until your chin is above the bar. Lower yourself back down with control.

exercises.name: Ab crunches
exercises.instruction: Sit on the ab crunch machine with your back against the pad and feet secured. Contract your abdominal muscles to crunch forward. Slowly return to the starting position while keeping tension on your core.
